# Wisal · وصال

Personal communication drafting for family, friends, colleagues and customers.
Android: Kotlin/Compose; desktop: Electron; optional Telegram and relay services remain separate.

Choose a person, intent, language and tone; edit two drafts; copy/share explicitly.
Arabic and English are the current focused message controls and local template languages.
Local templates remain available when hosted generation is disabled or unavailable and are clearly labeled.
Groq is optional, account-limited and not guaranteed free or unlimited. No paid/provider failover.
When enabled, prompt data may include names, relationships, notes, context and style examples.

Pages: /how-it-works (steps), /ai-principles (opt-in AI, limits, what is sent), /security (key storage, backups, safe updates, Wisal Direct status), /privacy.
English versions: /en/how-it-works, /en/ai-principles, /en/security, /en/privacy (the landing page is Arabic only).
Wisal Direct (device-to-device delivery) is under development and is not encrypted messaging yet; no encryption claim is made.

Source: https://github.com/ahmadzayan-hub/wisal
Android release channel: https://github.com/ahmadzayan-hub/wisal/releases/tag/android-latest
Windows release channel: https://github.com/ahmadzayan-hub/wisal/releases/tag/windows-latest
Release channels may predate current source. Verify Android signing continuity and higher versionCode; do not uninstall to bypass a signature mismatch.
